title: Meme machine Slack completion payload
description: Flat webhook payload consumed by Slack Workflow Builder. Every property is always present because Slack exposes webhook data as individually declared top-level variables.

type.description: The mutually exclusive value used by the first Slack branch step.

channel.description: Slack conversation ID used as the dynamic message destination.

requester.description: Slack member ID of the original requester.

content_url.description: Generated image, Saga file, or Saga directory URL; empty for failures and empty Saga lists.

text.description: Human-readable type-specific body: Saga provenance for images, current canon or newline-separated Saga names for `saga-context`, failure detail for failures, or empty for successful Saga updates.

cost_cents.description: Formatted generation cost including the cent symbol, or "not reported" for images without available usage; empty when no image was generated.

read_sagas.description: Comma-and-space-separated Saga names used as image context.

write_saga.description: Saga receiving the contribution; empty when no Saga is updated.

meme_id.description: Stable UUID for a generated image, reserved for future edit requests.
